heuristics.statement: Under the screened two-choice window law with WMAX_CAP=440,000,000, at least R_SAFE_LB=0.95286309 of the 944 F9 claws satisfy M_pre(i)<=W_SAFE=437,000,000. For every such claw, the exact B_CLAW=2,919,873 bound proves completion below the cap. The inherited EN_LB=4,414,590.97, MU_D=3,198,000, ESW1_UB=896, PI_BAR=2.31e-3 and Q4_UB=3.91e-4 premises apply as stated in the direct base.
heuristics.scope: The fixed target sha256-r39-prefix-v1 and the production Attack(win=2^26, k4=True, screen=1, wmax=440000000) path of experiments/r39joint_k8_both_c.py.
heuristics.extrapolation: The adjacent-slot source and panel law were preregistered before the 7,936 new windows ran (PREREG sha256 39dd14799a044573ac3dfa66d60af202b4891cfb7ee5ea5ff0a62622981d9411). Across seeds 8,600,001..8,608,192, the first 4,096 windows selected cap 440,000,000 on the frozen 400M..560M one-million grid by argmin((cap+6)/LCB); the disjoint second 4,096 windows had mean safe-claw retention 0.954175 and Bonferroni-6 LCB 0.95286309, priced without pooling. The common 2,048-seed paired check gave +0.058437 retention at 470M (1,997 wins, 51 ties, 0 losses). The finite panel supports, but does not prove, extrapolation to the full run; the exact cap-completion implication itself remains deterministic from B_CLAW=2,919,873 < 3,000,000 and W_SAFE=437,000,000. Full panel evidence is identified by CRAM library item L-311820b088.
heuristics.limitations: The full 2^26 Discovery/Holdout and 16,384-w co-hit panels are participant-run without cryptographic holdout_nonce pre-commitment (though Tuple 124 was selected purely algebraically, holdout seeds are contiguous, theoretical 9/128 F8 density matches to 0.012%, and 6-way Bonferroni FWER adjustment is applied). Organizer r39k4-window-small runs bounded 2^20/2^19 executable-consistency KATs rather than full-scale 2^26 statistical panels. Extrapolating from 256 holdout windows to ~2^73.94 windows assumes i.i.d. fresh M0 draws and independence of M_pre, s_safe, and equal-G structure from rounds 18..38 tails.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a W[17]==W17PUB hit of a valid Tuple-124 entry (a2, a3) in F8 x F9 x F10 x F11 (class 01: a0 even, W[1] odd), the full 39-round SHA-256 collision tail probability across rounds 18..38 is at least p_tail = 2^-74.446970, the 6-way Bonferroni class-01 lower bound of the preregistered 30,720-seed extended panel, and the independent-seed paired SMC estimator provides a calibrated empirical basis for this bound.
heuristics.scope: Rounds 18..38 collision tail of all 62,955,816 valid entries across all 48 kappa groups of Tuple 124 after exact 16-step two-message reconvergence.
heuristics.extrapolation: 28-seed contiguous paired ALL-48 SMC panel (seeds 1..28, NP=100, 4x40x2,048=327,680 trials/seed/arm, 9,175,040 trials/arm) sampling uniformly across all 62,955,816 entries via exact DP vs PUB control on bit-identical SMC carriers (l2 identical on 28/28 seeds; between-seed variance over 28 independent seeds captures within-seed resampling variance): T124-ALL48 yielded 1,246 verified full 39-round collisions (pooled mean 2^-74.37763, Bonf-6 LCB 2^-74.65170, 99.9% LCB 2^-74.67073; class-01 mean 2^-74.32531, Bonf-6 LCB 2^-74.71347, 99.9% single-parameter LCB 2^-74.74164; paired diff vs PUB +0.01666 bits, seed-mean +0.02237 +- 0.0591 bits). This derivative prices p_tail=2^-74.446970, the 6-way Bonferroni class-01 lower bound of a preregistered 30,720-seed extension (proof 5.3a; pooled class-01 mean 2^-74.438943, s.e. 0.0027 bit; PREREG sha256 d6a46a60eac857d73bcc803c607e362676cb0b3d5c71ae5ec4f8b44765ac3c75 (n=512, seeds 100001..100512), 73fab15e07e42801d6792b1d305b3e297f30187f37bd9231018650a1fe63bb91 (n=2,048, seeds 200001..202048), 6d807efc6e98b8fc08c5cd9de5a9ecae7b0f89363d257c13d96c8ec44d0dfb9e (n=7,680, seeds 300001..307680), 7b052492775d0f4dde9c9234a565f1d5323260d70a5982074ed8ae858a8cfb2a (n=20,480, seeds 400001..420480)). Organizer-executable r39-mate-01..14 replays the exact paired SMC engine (1x40x2,048 trials/arm on identical carriers across 14 public seeds, KAT total 165 T124 vs 152 PUB verified 39-round SFS collisions).
heuristics.limitations: The 28-seed SMC panel is participant-run without cryptographic holdout_nonce pre-commitment (though Tuple 124 was selected algebraically, seeds 1..28 are contiguous, PUB parity is +0.01666 bits, and the priced p_tail=2^-74.446970 is the Bonf-6 class-01 LCB of the preregistered 30,720-seed participant extension, also without a nonce and a statistically equivalent rebuild of the 28-seed estimator, not a bit replay). SMC samples rounds 18..23 from the exact step-16/17 pinned state with uniform F8 x F9 draws for W[8], W[9] and random recovered cv rather than real screened walk claws (a0 even, u odd, k4_scr(cv)<=5); invariance of the tail under cv screening and claw selection, as well as SMC estimator calibration, are explicit heuristic premises of H2-entries.

Organizer-executable r39-transplant-claw verifies the shipped 39-round SFS collision (sfs_collision=1), the full 48-group / 1,088-class / 52-block import builder (K4_MEM=1,042,561 B), 48/48 group samples on h4ok, W[9], W[16], and 16-step two-message reconvergence, 48/48 planted k4q hits, and 255/255 seeded random checks. heuristics.statement: Across screened F9 claws, the claw-dependent offset (u, w2b) causes each listed key (a2, kappa) to hit W[17]==W17PUB with probability 2^-32, independently of F8 membership, rounds 18..38 tail outcomes, and W[17] hits on other claws.
heuristics.scope: W[17] hit probability in k4q for all 9,906,695 distinct keys of Tuple 124 and cross-claw product in the second-order Bonferroni bound.
heuristics.extrapolation: Algebraic decoupling W[17] = u + s0(a2 + w2b) - a2 - kappa (Section 2.3), 48/48 planted-key recovery + 100-claw random equivalence check (46 survivors observed vs ~45.5 expected, 0 mismatches vs linear scan), and organizer-executable r39-transplant-claw / r39k4-window-small KATs.
heuristics.limitations: Exact 2^-32 W[17] hit probability and independence from rounds 18..38 tails are modeled heuristically; rare ~2^-10 per-claw hits cannot be tested jointly with 2^-74.8 full collisions at scale.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a colliding Tuple-124 entry (a2, a3), its W[3] word is approximately uniform mod 2^32, so the exhaustive 2^32 bad-set sum max_{a3} sum_{b3!=a3 in group} |B_{b3-a3}| = 3,113,266 bounds within-key mate collision overlap pointwise by eps_mate/2 = 3,113,266 / 2^33 = 3.624319e-4.
heuristics.scope: Within-key mate Bonferroni deduction over all 62,955,816 entries (1,088 classes, 48 groups, 230 distinct mate offsets).
heuristics.extrapolation: Exhaustive 2^32 W[3] enumeration over all 230 distinct mate offsets of Tuple 124 proved 0 zero-Delta occurrences across all 230 offsets and exact pointwise worst-case sum 3,113,266/2^32; 28-seed ALL-48 SMC panel verified W[3] per-bit chi^2(32)=28.72 across 1,246 real hits (99.9% cutoff 62.49) and 0/972 F8-passing mates surviving row 19 (337 at row 18, 635 at row 19); organizer-executable r39-mate-01..14 traces every reached F8-passing mate live (KAT total 0/120 through row 19).
heuristics.limitations: Exhaustive enumeration proves |B_d| and 0 zero-Delta unconditionally; mapping |B_d|/2^32 to conditional overlap probability relies on W[3] uniformity conditioned on a full collision, tested via 32 marginal bit counts on 1,246 SMC hits rather than proved cryptographically.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a collision at one claw of a window, another claw's key hit on the same chaining value cv follows the rounds 18..19 trail (and hence collides) with probability at most EPS_KEY = 2^-7.
heuristics.scope: Cross-claw pair term D_cross = (896 * 3,198,000 * 2^-7) / 2^33 = 2.606073e-3 inside the window second-order Bonferroni divisor DIV.
heuristics.extrapolation: 28-seed paired ALL-48 panel tested 1,246 colliding cv clusters (64 virtual other-claw trials per hit -> 79,744 clustered trials per arm, real hit cv vs uniform random cv): xa18=40,152 vs xu18=40,046 (ratio 1.00265) and xa20=0, xu20=0. Because blocks of 64 trials share a single hit cv, we do not claim an i.i.d. n=79,744 Clopper-Pearson bound; EPS_KEY=2^-7 is a declared heuristic ceiling supported by exact parity with the random-cv row-19 survival baseline (~2^-18..2^-22, leaving >8 bits of heuristic headroom even after a 32-mate union bound). Organizer-executable r39-mate-01..14 repeats 32 cross-claw virtual trials/hit drawn from a fresh size-proportional group gi2 across 14 organizer-seeded runs (KAT total 0/5,280 xa20, xa18=2,655 vs xu18=2,620).
heuristics.limitations: Measured on clustered virtual other-claw trials (_xd pins W[17] by solving w[1] without parity restriction) using SMC-generated colliding chaining values rather than real screened-window claw pairs; deeper rows 20..38 are covered by event inclusion.
